toolsSecurity.intro: Manage security policies for desktop and remote IM actions, confirmation memory and security audit in one place. Changes apply immediately and are written to the audit log.

policy.title: Policy Packages
policy.hint: Choose a policy package per lane. The custom package lets you adjust rule actions; system-protection rules are toggled via Enabled/Disabled.
policy.currentStandardAvailable: A newer IM standard policy is available
policy.currentStandardAvailableHint: Review the changes and confirm to switch the shared WeChat and Feishu policy.
policy.switchToCurrentStandardTitle: Switch to the current IM standard policy?
policy.switchToCurrentStandardIntro: The new standard changes these approval decisions:
policy.switchToCurrentStandardGateNote: The standard policy sends actions eligible for automatic review to the review Agent; actions requiring human approval are still sent to you. Asynchronous approval notifications are a separate feature.
policy.switchToCurrentStandardSuccess: The current IM standard policy is active.

behaviorDiffs.mcpPublicReadAuto: Public web fetching and other classified read-only MCP calls enter automatic review instead of asking you directly each time.
behaviorDiffs.lowRiskBrowserAndFeishuAuto: Ordinary browser navigation and classified low-risk Feishu actions enter automatic review.
behaviorDiffs.sensitiveWriteAndExternalOutboundManual: Writes to sensitive files or system directories, and messages to other people or groups, still require your approval. Ordinary file overwrites are reviewed by the approval agent.

policy.strictHint: Strict: you confirm ordinary outbound, sensitive content, and writes outside the working directory each time. Other rules follow the strict tier.
policy.standardHint: Standard: the security approval agent reviews ordinary desktop outbound and writes outside the working directory; sensitive content and other human-required cases still require your confirmation. Other desktop asks follow the precheck and approval-agent flow; remote rules keep their configured behavior.
policy.imStandardHint: Current standard: ordinary IM writes are reviewed by the approval agent. Writes to sensitive files or system directories, and messages to other people or groups, still require your confirmation.
policy.looseHint: Relaxed: ordinary outbound runs directly, sensitive content is reviewed by the security approval agent, and writes outside the working directory are reviewed by that agent. Other rules follow the relaxed tier. Make sure you understand the risk.
policy.customHint: Custom: adjust each rule action below (desktop lane: deny/allow/ask/auto; remote lanes: deny/allow/ask).
policy.saveConflict: The policy changed elsewhere. Refresh and try again.
policy.packageSelectHint: The package sets the default for all rules below; choose Custom to override per rule.
policy.larkWriteRequiresConfirmHint: Off by default: Feishu CLI writes (messages, docs, calendar, etc.) skip confirmation. Writes can affect group chats, shared docs, and calendars—broader external impact than WeChat private reply. Turn on when you want confirmation. Under the custom package, rule overrides for lark-write-ask take precedence over this switch.

memory.title: Confirmation Memory

memory.actHighRiskKeywordsHint: Act instructions matching these keywords always require confirmation and never use trust.
memory.hint: Remembered answers (do-not-ask-again) from the decision_cache. Clearing an entry means it will ask again next time.

audit.retentionHint: Audit files older than the retention period are cleaned up automatically (default 180 days).

preflight.unknown: Preflight found an issue it could not identify. Review the task description and try again.

preflight.root_facts_unavailable: The selected work directories could not be checked. Confirm they exist and are accessible.
preflight.facts_incomplete: The selected work directories could not be checked completely, so the target cannot be confirmed. Narrow the directory scope and try again.
preflight.analyzer_unavailable: The preflight service could not complete the request, so the task was not saved. Try again later; if it keeps happening, contact the application maintainer.
preflight.analyzer_timeout: Preflight did not finish within its 60-second total limit, so the task was not saved and no permissions were granted. Lower the task reasoning effort or choose a faster model, then try again.
preflight.analyzer_summary_timeout: The simulation stopped, but the separate permission summary did not finish in time. The task was not saved and no permissions were granted. Lower the task reasoning effort or choose a faster model, then try again.
preflight.analyzer_invalid_response: The preflight result did not pass format or permission-scope validation, so the task was not saved. Try again; if this continues, contact the maintainer and include the application log.
preflight.analyzer_output_truncated: The preflight model did not return a complete result within this request's output length, so the task was not saved. Try again; if it keeps happening, switch to a model that supports longer outputs.
preflight.mock_preflight_incomplete: Preflight could not verify the complete permission list, so the task was not saved. Try preflight again; if it still fails, note the time and contact the application maintainer.
preflight.target_unclear: The file, directory, or scope to process could not be identified. Add a specific target to the task prompt.
preflight.target_ambiguous: This description matches multiple locations. Choose one candidate and add its full path to the task prompt.

preflight.target_outside_roots: This target is outside the authorized directories. Add its read/write directory or change the target path in the task prompt.
preflight.target_unverifiable: This target could not be verified safely. Use a regular file or directory inside the selected work directories.
preflight.target_type_mismatch: The target found does not match the requested file or directory type. Check the name.

preflight.output_path_escape: The output location is outside the selected work directories. Move it inside one of the selected directories.
preflight.output_ancestor_invalid: The parent directory for this output could not be verified. Check the output path and choose an existing work directory.

Changes to the task or its access scope require confirmation again. The security review agent still checks each concrete call and its arguments against the approved scope at runtime.
form.permissionReviewPartialCoverage: The mock rehearsal reached its time or call budget, and a separate summary session organized the calls recorded so far. The list may omit later calls that were not observed; runtime requests outside the list remain blocked and require a new preflight.
form.preflightDraftChanged: The form changed during preflight, so the old permission list was discarded. Run preflight again.
